contentBody: **A group first says "ship to everyone," then later agrees "ship to 10% first." What goes in the final decisions list?**
option.1: Both, listed as two separate decisions

answerExplanation: The last word on a topic wins; note that the decision changed.

contentBody: **A task was raised but nobody agreed to own it. What should the action item say for the owner?**
option.1: Assign it to the person who raised it

contentBody: **Which prompt instruction best prevents invented details in a summary?**
option.1: "Make it sound confident, polished and professional"
option.2: "Be as creative as possible with the wording"

option.4: "Keep it as short as you possibly can"
answerExplanation: A source-only rule stops the AI filling gaps with plausible details.

option.1: Checking the word count of the summary
